title: Economics textbook, 6th edition
description: A useful companion for introductory economics. A few highlighted passages and handwritten notes; all pages intact. Check your course reading list for the correct edition.

title: Adjustable study lamp
description: Warm and cool light settings with an adjustable neck. Includes the power cable. A small scuff on the base, but all settings work in this fictional listing.

title: Wireless keyboard
description: Compact Bluetooth keyboard for a less cluttered desk. Includes two AAA batteries. US keyboard layout; no original packaging.

title: Everyday campus backpack
description: Navy backpack with a padded 13-inch laptop sleeve and two bottle pockets. Clean inside, with light wear on the straps.

title: Badminton racket & cover
description: Lightweight beginner racket for casual games between classes. Comes with a protective cover. Grip has some wear and may need replacing.

title: Desk organiser set
description: Three stackable trays and a matching pen cup. Handy for stationery and lecture notes. Giving these away after a room clear-out.

title: Scientific calculator
description: Non-programmable scientific calculator with a slide-on cover. Check your module's exam rules before choosing a calculator.

title: Introduction to Python
description: Beginner programming book with exercises on functions, collections and small projects. No writing inside. A fictional catalogue item, not a course recommendation.

title: Linear algebra revision guide
description: Worked examples, formula summaries, and practice questions for first-year maths. A few pencil ticks on completed exercises.

title: A4 graph-paper notebook bundle
description: Four partly unused graph-paper notebooks for calculations, diagrams, and lab work. About three quarters of the pages remain in each.

title: Organic chemistry model kit
description: Colour-coded atoms and bonds for visualising common molecular structures. One small connector is missing, but the kit is otherwise complete.

title: Exam-approved scientific calculator
description: Non-programmable calculator with fraction, statistics, and equation functions. Includes a protective cover; please check your module rules.

title: Data structures textbook
description: Paperback reference covering algorithms, trees, graphs, and complexity. Highlighting is limited to the first two chapters.

title: Noise-reducing study earplugs
description: Reusable silicone earplugs with a small carry case for library study sessions or residence halls. Cleaned and packed for this demo listing.

title: USB-C laptop hub
description: Seven-in-one hub with HDMI, USB-A, SD card, and USB-C power pass-through ports. Used with a MacBook; cable included.

title: 24-inch monitor with stand
description: Full HD monitor for a larger study desk setup. HDMI cable and original adjustable stand included; no dead pixels noticed in this fictional demo.

title: Bluetooth mouse
description: Quiet-click wireless mouse with an ergonomic shape and USB receiver. Battery compartment is clean and the scroll wheel works smoothly.

title: Portable phone tripod
description: Small flexible tripod for recording presentations, club videos, or video calls. Includes a spring phone clamp and drawstring pouch.

title: Over-ear wired headphones
description: Comfortable closed-back headphones with a 3.5 mm plug and replacement ear pads. Great for a quiet desk setup; no microphone included.
location: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences

title: Mechanical keyboard, compact
description: 65 percent keyboard with tactile switches, white backlight, and detachable USB-C cable. A few keycaps show light shine from use.

title: Folding study desk
description: Compact white desk suitable for a residence room, with a shallow drawer for stationery. Minor marks on the surface; folds flat for pickup.

title: Ergonomic desk chair
description: Black mesh chair with adjustable height and lumbar support. The armrests are fixed, and one caster has cosmetic scuffs.

title: Under-bed storage drawers
description: Two clear rolling drawers for clothes, cables, or room supplies. One drawer has a small crack at the corner but still closes.

title: Bedside shelf lamp
description: Clip-on lamp with three brightness levels and a USB charging port. Fits a bed frame or slim shelf; power adapter included.

title: Laundry basket and hanger set
description: Collapsible laundry basket plus twelve plastic hangers for a move-in or room refresh. All pieces are clean and usable.

title: Electric kettle, 1 litre
description: Compact kettle for hot drinks and instant meals in a permitted pantry area. Boils normally; exterior has a small scratch near the handle.

title: Yoga mat with carry strap
description: Non-slip 6 mm mat for stretching, yoga, or floor workouts. Wipes clean and rolls tightly; there is light wear at one end.

title: Adjustable dumbbell pair
description: Two compact adjustable dumbbells with spin-lock collars and plates up to 10 kg each. Best collected from residence due to weight.

title: Football boots, UK size 8
description: Synthetic turf football boots with a responsive sole. Used for one intramural season; studs and laces are intact.

title: Insulated water bottle, 750 ml
description: Stainless steel bottle that keeps drinks cold through long class days. A few tiny exterior dents, but the lid does not leak.

title: Pour-over coffee starter set
description: Plastic dripper, glass server, scoop, and reusable filter for a simple dorm-pantry coffee setup. No coffee beans included.

title: Canvas tote bag, library print
description: Roomy cotton tote with an internal pocket for a notebook and charger. The print is fictional campus artwork; machine washed once.

title: Instant camera with film case
description: Simple instant camera with a protective case and unopened film storage box. Battery door is secure; film is not included.

title: Rain jacket, unisex medium
description: Lightweight hooded rain jacket for walking between lectures. Packs into its own pocket; one reflective strip has slight peeling.

title: Running belt and armband
description: Small zip running belt and phone armband for evening jogs. Elastic is still firm and both zips work.

title: Laptop sleeve, 13 inch
description: Padded grey sleeve with a front pocket for a charger and cables. Fits most 13-inch laptops; zip pulls show light wear.
